messages:
maria-ops: Hey team — can someone take a quick look at this PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2785 :eyes:

maria-ops: TL;DR: Terraform change that does two things:
- add a taint/replace helper for the gpu_pool ASG so we can rotate problematic nodes without draining the whole pool
- fix route propagation for the gpu subnets (missing tag caused propagation to stop during a failover)

ajenkins: can pick this up in ~30m. quick question: expected customer impact? maintenance window?

maria-ops: No customer-visible downtime expected. Plan is rolling replacement: create new instances, migrate workloads, then destroy old ones. I'm planning to run the apply during the 3pm PT maintenance window to be safe. Need one infra approval + an ops signoff for the route propagation change.

samir: quick heads-up: the route propagation change touches the shared RT used by the job-queues. Please verify we don't accidentally re-associate the wrong RTB with the peering connection. Also can you paste the diff from `terraform plan -target=module.gpu_pool`? :mag:

maria-ops: pasted plan snippet below:
```hcl
# module.gpu_pool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu (planned start)
+ resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu" {
+   name = "gpu-pool-v2"
+   max_size = 10
+   min_size = 2
+   desired_capacity = 4
+ }
# module.gpu_subnet.aws_route_table_association.gpu (update in-place)
~ route_table_id: "rtb-old" => "rtb-new"
```

maria-ops: The RTB update is constrained to the gpu-subnet module only; I added a selector so other modules won't pick it up.

nisha: nit: add `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on the ASG so we avoid a replace blip. Also suggest adding an explicit `depends_on = [aws_route_table.gpu]` where you reference the new RT to force ordering.

infra-bot: CI: terraform fmt ✔︎, terraform validate ✔︎, plan ✔︎ (1 warning: deprecated attribute `associate_public_ip_address`)

ajenkins: skimmed the plan — looks sane. please add the lifecycle change nisha suggested and re-run plan, then I'm +1. :thumbsup:

samir: can you also confirm peering's route table entries after apply? If you want I can run a quick smoke test against the job-queue after you apply.

maria-ops: will add lifecycle and depends_on now, re-run plan and post back. Samir that'd be great — if you can do the smoke test 3:15pm PT that works.

maria-ops: updated and re-planned, new plan uploaded to PR. infra-bot: plan OK again.

ajenkins: LGTM, approving in GH.

samir: checked the plan for peering side-effects, looks isolated. +1 from me after smoke test passes.

maria-ops: thanks! will merge at 3pm PT and run apply during maintenance window. tagging ops for visibility. :rocket:

nisha: thanks for the follow-up, please watch the ASG metrics for 30m after the rotate. :eyes:

maria-ops: will do. thanks everyone :heart:
